description: This source file defines the PaymentController class, which handles REST API endpoints related to payments, including order creation and payment verification, using services RazorpayService and OrderService.

classes.name: PaymentController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller that manages payment-related endpoints, utilizing dependency-injected services RazorpayService and OrderService.

methods.name: createRazorpayOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a Razorpay order based on provided payment request details, returns a RazorpayOrderResponse.

methods.name: verifyPayment
methods.description: Handles POST requests to verify a payment based on the verification request data, returns an OrderResponse.
